keyEvents.text: Goal! Querétaro 1, Necaxa 0. Alí Ávila (Querétaro) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mateo Coronel with a cross.
Goal! Querétaro 1, Necaxa 1. Emilio Rodríguez (Necaxa) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Diego Ochoa.
Delay in match because of an injury Danny Leyva (Necaxa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Querétaro. Santiago Homenchenko replaces Jesús Arellano.
Substitution, Querétaro. Álex Alcalá replaces Iker Benito.
Delay in match because of an injury Danny Leyva (Necaxa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lucas Abascia (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Necaxa. Juan Valencia replaces Owen González.
